title: Nguoi khong lo Cardiff: Bi lat tay la thach cao, sao Broadway van ban ve ca hai?
description:
Thang 10 nam 1869, viec dao gieng tren mot trang trai New York da phat hien nguoi khong lo hoa da cao 3 met, gay chan dong nuoc My.
Nhung khi giao su Yale phat hien vet duc moi va bao chi truy ra xuong dieu khac o Chicago, Broadway van ngang nhien trung bay hai nguoi khong lo gia de ban ve!

chapters.7jnm: Mua thu 1869: Dao gieng trang trai phat hien nguoi da 3 met

chapters.jkea: Giao su Yale cui xuong: Phat hien toan vet duc moi tren da
chapters.qsgn: Thu tu mo da Iowa: Hanh trinh mot nam cua chiec thung go lon
chapters.3pvi: Xuong lam viec Chicago: Dung kim thep tao ra 100 nghin lo chan long
chapters.a7jp: Truoc sanh Apollo o Broadway: Hai nguoi khong lo cung tranh khach
chapters.h7v2: Tham phan tuyen bo: Hay de nguoi khong lo cua ban tu den tuyen the
chapters.ah2n: Dong dau ho so: Bai hoc bao chi tu hai tam ve Broadway

89rb.text: Ban da tung nghe ve vu an ky la nay chua?

uz9i.text: Duoi mot trang trai o tieu bang New York,

smrr.text: Nguoi ta dao duoc mot nguoi da khong lo cao 3 met!

zbz8.text: Cao bang ca toa nha hai tang!

32tb.text: Lieu do co thuc su la nguoi khong lo tien su?

bkes.text: Hay than thoai co xua da tro thanh su that?

gi2a.text: Ca nuoc My khi do phat cuong vi phat hien nay,

8n6c.text: Hang van nguoi do xo xep hang de xem!

pgn8.text: Trang trai dung leu lon va tang gia ve tung ngay!

uqug.text: Ca vung khong ai noi ve dieu gi khac ngoai nguoi da nay!

y89n.text: Nhung chi hai thang sau do,

wivm.text: Cac nha khoa hoc Yale da vach tran tro lua ngay tai tran!

8uh9.text: Truy ra can ke nguon goc cua tang da khong lo nay!

8vrw.text: Day hoan toan khong phai hoa thach co xua!

qqey.text: Bi vach tran la hang gia sao?

n4dd.text: Vay chang phai moi nguoi giai tan ve nha het sao?

j56w.text: Hom nay chung ta hay cung tim hieu cau chuyen ky la nay,

gwa9.text: Cuoc chien ban ve giua hai nguoi khong lo o Broadway!

siju.text: Tro lai thoi diem mua thu nam 1869.

pbhr.text: Tai mot trang trai o thi tran nho Cardiff, New York.

4wng.text: Nuoc suoi tu nhien da chay trong veo ngay canh nha!

7exf.text: Vay can gi phai ton tien dao gieng lam gi?

cy2c.text: Nhung chu trang trai lai dot nhien muon dao gieng.

3j9g.text: Ong ta thue hai nguoi tho den dao gieng.

4s6v.text: Va chi ro dia diem cu the ngay phia sau chuong ngua!

c2mb.text: Khi dao sau xuong khoang mot met,

3pey.text: Chiec xeng dot ngot vang len tieng keng thanh thot!

cdma.text: Duoi lop bun dat lo ra mot ngon chan cai khong lo hoa da!

qmmb.text: Vai gio sau, toan bo tuong da khong lo duoc dao len,

efwi.text: Dai 3 met va nang gan 1,4 tan!

qvw4.text: Gan mot tan ruoi! That la khong lo!

gkx5.text: Tin tuc lan khap New York chi trong nua ngay!

yiim.text: Cac to bao lon dong loat dua tin tren trang nhat!

27vp.text: Chu trang trai lap tuc dung mot chiec leu trang khong lo!

3wna.text: Xe ngua xep hang cho xem keo dai hang cay so!

m9wm.text: Gia ve vao cua tang vot tu 25 xu len 50 xu!

nf3z.text: Thu ve hang chuc nghin do la chi trong vai tuan!

aw4u.text: Mot tap doan o Syracuse dua ra 37.000 do la,

fcfi.text: Mua lai ba phan tu co phan cua nguoi khong lo!

9rii.text: Ngay ca cong ty duong sat cung hot bac nho chay them chuyen!

9v8a.text: Cac khach san gan do luc nao cung kin cho khong con mot phong!

w6s4.text: 37.000 do la! Mot con so khong lo thoi do!

5tt3.text: Nhung chang le khong co hoc gia nao kiem tra xem that hay gia?

323g.text: Tat nhien la co! Cac hoc gia lap tuc den tan noi.

hg84.text: Nhieu nguoi tin chac day la bang chung nguoi khong lo trong Kinh Thanh!

x2sq.text: Cac vi linh muc lan loi tu xa den de chiem nguong!

ujs4.text: Ngay ca cuu Thong doc New York cung cong khai ung ho!

smri.text: Cho den dau thang 11 khi chuyen gia hang dau cua Yale xuat hien!

tayy.text: Lieu vi giao su lung danh cua Yale co tin khong?

xpb9.text: Giao su Marsh lung danh dich than den kiem tra.

e8bz.text: Ong chi quan sat vai phut roi cuoi nhat!

q7ht.text: Tren be mat chi chit nhung vet duc con moi nguyen!

ewya.text: Nhung nhat duc cua tho khong he duoc nguy trang!

nkbh.text: Hoa thach co xua sao co the co vet duc moi nhu the!

yi6z.text: Hon nua chat da chi la thach cao mem,

xvhr.text: Hoan toan khong phai da cam thach ben vung!

tc2p.text: Thach cao nam trong dat am se som tan thanh nuoc!

gyye.text: Chi can mot chut kien thuc dia chat la nhan ra ngay!

ktm8.text: Giao su Marsh lap tuc viet bai gui cho bao chi:

r6eq.text: Tuyen bo day la mot tro lua dao hoan toan ro rang!

8mpj.text: Dich than giao su Yale da vach tran no!

xrmi.text: Vay nguoi da nay rot cuoc do ai lam ra?

x5qb.text: Cac phong vien da truy theo van don duong sat!

7kkg.text: Chiec thung go lon nang 3 tan de lai dau vet ro rang,

rpaj.text: Cac nhan vien duong sat deu nho nhu in kien hang khong lo do!

676q.text: Ke chu muu la mot nguoi ten la George Hull.

dthr.text: Mot thuong nhan ban xi ga sao?

879i.text: Sao ong ta phai mat cong che tao nguoi da lam gi?

qgnn.text: Bat nguon tu cuoc tranh luan gay gat hai nam truoc,

6s5d.text: Doi phuong khang khang moi loi trong Kinh Thanh deu la that!

55iw.text: Khuyen rang thoi co dai thuc su co nguoi khong lo tren mat dat!

xmnr.text: La nguoi vo than, ong ta da len ke hoach tra dua the nao?

99d6.text: Hull la nguoi vo than va tuc gian den mat ngu.

88f6.text: Ong quyet dinh lam mot nguoi khong lo gia de che nhao su tin mu quang!

b4au.text: Nam truoc ong mua mot khoi thach cao o Iowa,

3hbe.text: Dua khoi thach cao nang 5 tan len tau hoa,

j6r8.text: Hull dich than di cung de bao ve an toan!

gwgf.text: Ong noi doi la de tac tuong tuong niem Tong thong Lincoln,

85es.text: Lua duong sat van chuyen khoi da den Chicago!

dj5y.text: Dung ca Tong thong Lincoln lam cai co!

9j93.text: Ong bi mat dieu khac trong mot chuong ngua o Chicago,

y8gw.text: Chung ta hay den xem xuong lam viec bi mat do!

zruy.text: Khoi thach cao 5 tan ma khong ai nghi ngo gi sao!

qjc6.text: Ai cung tuong do la tuong danh tang Tong thong Lincoln!

3ygp.text: Hull thue mot can phong bi mat o Chicago,

mfg8.text: Thue hai nguoi tho dieu khac nguoi Duc lam viec bi mat!

2auk.text: Cac tho dieu khac dung chinh Hull lam mau khoa than,

yy39.text: Duc lien tuc trong suot muoi bon tuan le!

nnaz.text: Hien truong che tac bi mat trong chuong ngua,

nrhk.text: Hull ngay nao cung co mat de giam sat!

txxk.text: Con ket cau da cua hoa thach co thi sao?

8za7.text: Da moi duc trong se qua nhan nhui!

vevb.text: Do chinh la cho the hien su tinh vi cua Hull!

7zvv.text: Cac tho dieu khac lam nhung chiec bua chi cam kim thep,

rsmh.text: Dap tung nhat de tao ra mot tram nghin lo chan long!

jxu5.text: Mo phong hoan hao ket cau chan long cua da nguoi!

ay5a.text: Dap ca tram nghin lo chan long! Qua la tinh xao!

fc3r.text: Sau do ho do axit sulfuric va muc len tuong,

8ktw.text: Tao ra nhung vet o vang phong hoa nhu hang nghin nam,

8prg.text: Lam cho no trong nhu da nam duoi long dat hang the ky!

ywcq.text: Hull bi mat chon no duoi trang trai cua nguoi ho hang.

sz43.text: Chon suot mot nam troi moi gia vo dao duoc!

4wp7.text: Toan bo chi phi cho man lua dao chi 2.200 do la.

iyam.text: Ton 2.200 ma kiem duoc hang chuc nghin tien ve!

q7rs.text: Vay sao lai co nguoi khong lo thu hai xuat hien?

y2s6.text: Day moi la cao trao dien ro nhat cua toan bo vu an!

nccy.text: Ong trum xiec P. T. Barnum dich than tim den!

p88i.text: Ong trum giai tri danh hoi thay mui tien bac beo bo!

5tcx.text: Ong ta tra gia tu 50.000 den 60.000 do de thue!

st29.text: Nhung chu so huu cua tap doan lap tuc tu choi thang thung!

n8uw.text: Lieu Barnum bi tu choi co chiu bo cuoc khong?

sck2.text: Tu bo khong bao gio co trong tu dien cua Barnum!

9zxh.text: Cac nguoi khong cho thue thi ta tu lam lay!

z55y.text: Ong sai mat tham do kich thuoc va do khuon thach cao!

p7vf.text: Chi trong vai ngay da tao ra mot ban sao y het!

6dw4.text: Barnum nhanh chan dua ban sao den Broadway trung bay!

efnu.text: Broadway bong xuat hien hai nguoi khong lo cung luc,

yqdg.text: Ban goc cung duoc chuyen den doi dien tai Apollo Hall!

xuab.text: Hai phong trung bay chi cach nhau vai tram met doi dau!

rswm.text: Broadway ngay nao cung dien ra tran chien gianh khach!

kydw.text: Hai nguoi khong lo gianh giat khach tren cung mot con pho!

459w.text: Barnum con quang ba rang ben kia moi la do gia!

kv97.text: Hang gia lai bao hang gia khac la hang gia!

nzev.text: Khan gia biet la gia nhung van tranh nhau mua ve vao xem!

bwwb.text: Ai cung muon xem hai mon do gia nay cai nao trong that hon!

ubpf.text: Cai mieng cua Barnum thi dung la khong ai sanh bang!

ftam.text: Hai ben mua chuoc cac to bao de danh nhau bang but chien!

8bzd.text: Ket qua la Barnum kiem duoc nhieu tien hon ca ban goc!

c23e.text: Nhom so huu ban goc tuc dien nguoi kien Barnum ra toa!

gg67.text: Chi trich Barnum la ke dao nhai khong biet xau ho!

6k4x.text: Kien Barnum vi pham ban quyen va yeu cau tich thu!

eujd.text: Lieu vu kien nay co the thang duoc khong?

9esz.text: Du sao thi ban goc cung chi la tuong thach cao lam gia!

xkxx.text: Phien toa tro thanh tro cuoi lon nhat ca thanh pho,

eb8t.text: Bao chi dang tin hai huoc moi ngay tren trang nhat!

pibm.text: Vi tham phan tuyen mot cau kinh dien voi luat su nguyen don:

h2vb.text: Hay bao nguoi khong lo cua ong dich than den day tuyen the!

fdfr.text: Bao mot khoi thach cao gio tay tuyen the sao!

xnph.text: Toa an da lap tuc bac don kien cua nguyen don!

kkr3.text: Phap luat khong the bao ho doc quyen cho mot tro lua dao.

qri7.text: Ban than la tro lua thi khong co quyen ngan cam nguoi khac sao chep!

d9yh.text: Nhung nguoi tho o Chicago tham chi con dang quang cao tren bao,

tgzw.text: Nhan dieu khac bat ky tuong than tien su nao theo yeu cau!

3chd.text: Nhan dat hang moi loai nguoi da co dai theo yeu cau!

2pxk.text: Ai cung co the tu dao duoc nguoi khong lo trong vuon nha minh!

2p23.text: Mot phien toa thu vi dung tro lua de danh bai tro lua!

qbp9.text: Hang gia kien hang gia vi pham that la chua tung co!

ceue.text: Phan quyet cua tham phan tro thanh an le kinh dien trong lich su!

2unw.text: Man kich khep lai va con sot cung dan lang xuong.

iscb.text: Ke chu muu George Hull cuoi cung da cong khai thu nhan tat ca.

2a5y.text: Nguoi da dau tien khong he bi dap pha hay vut bo,

4j9u.text: Ma tro thanh mot huyen thoai bat tu trong van hoa dai chung!

9iex.text: Nam 1947 duoc dua vao Bao tang Nong dan o Cooperstown.

zeaw.text: Hien van dang nam yen binh trong phong trung bay cho khach tham quan!

hasc.text: Hon mot the ky troi qua, nguoi ta van muon den xem.

44k3.text: Vi sao lai nhu vay nhi?

gfgf.text: Moi nguoi mua ve khong phai de xem mot di tich co xua,

xywb.text: Ma la de chung vui voi niem yeu thich phep mau cua con nguoi!

cyfv.text: Con nguoi luon khao khat duoc rung dong truoc nhung phep mau,

9d24.text: Va do chinh la ma luc thuc su cua Nguoi khong lo Cardiff!

2a4t.text: Ho so chuyen la, ho so so 183 chinh thuc khep lai!

mfyz.text: Tro lua dao vi dai nay that la hap dan!

z2h5.text: Rieng tien ve da vuot qua ca tien du tru cua cac ngan hang dia phuong!

6ys5.text: Man kich gia nay dien con song dong hon ca su that!

tizp.text: Barnum con mang nguoi khong lo gia di luu dien khap nuoc My!

gx84.text: Moi diem dung chan deu thu hut bien nguoi den xem!

582y.text: Chuyen luu dien cua hang gia ma con hot hon ca hang that!

tnbn.text: Dung la mot bai hoc xuat sac ve tam ly dam dong!

zert.text: Doi khi con nguoi ta tha tin vao mot ao tuong dep de!

6x6q.text: Boi vi ao tuong thu vi hon hien thuc don dieu rat nhieu!

4gd9.text: Nhung chuyen la trong lich su con ly ky hon ca tieu thuyet!

rteq.text: Du su that bi phoi bay, cau chuyen van luu truyen mai mai!

2epz.text: Su to mo luon mang phep mau manh me hon ca su that.

sbrx.text: Ban co mua ve de xem nguoi khong lo gia noi tieng nay khong?

5g8i.text: Hay de lai y kien thao luan va dang ky kenh Ho so chuyen la nhe!
